### 项目原则 / Project principles

本项目坚持：只在本机运行、单人使用、隐私优先、依赖尽量少；不做托管服务，不绕过验证码、限流或任何访问控制，不抓取没有开放的接口。超出这些原则的建议可能不会被采纳，但欢迎讨论。

The project stays local-only, single-user, privacy-first and dependency-light. It will not become a hosted service and will never bypass captchas, rate limits or access controls, or scrape non-public interfaces.

- [ ] 我认为这个建议符合上述原则 / I believe this fits the principles above
